## Recall <version> for Windows

**What's new**
- …

**Install**
Download `RecallSetup.exe` and run it. An installed Recall offers the update by itself; your settings are kept.

**Code signing**
Free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://signpath.io), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). See the [code signing policy](https://github.com/LoneBeast27/recall/blob/main/CODE_SIGNING_POLICY.md).

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the installer's checksum, and `SOURCE-REVISION.txt` names the exact source commit.
